name: Ring of Spell Consumption, Minor
body:
Aura faint evocation; CL 5th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a minor ring of spell storing and functions as such. The wearer may cast up to three levels of spells into the ring as normal. Any spell cast into the ring, however, has a 20% chance of being consumed. Additionally, any spell of 3rd level or less the wearer attempts to cast has a 10% chance of being consumed by the ring.

Casting remove curse on the wearer will allow the wearer to remove the ring and negates its magical ability. There is a 5% cumulative chance per spell level successfully stored that the ring erupts with a blast of force dealing 1d6 points per spell level stored to all creatures within 10′.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of spell storing, minor

Identification DC 30
False Identification DC 20
